globalCodeData_B4.impactVector: Detectives investigated a report received November 3, 2026, at Aso Pada Division and arrested 23-year-old Yusuf Musa and 32-year-old Victor Zamani over the killing of 50-year-old Jude Thaddeus in Aku Village, Karu LGA, exhuming his burned body from a dry well. Suspects allegedly sold the deceased's heavy metals and industrial engines for ₦3,400,000, while a third suspect remains at large under intensified pursuit. The case was transferred to SCID Lafia, with no formal victim restitution or full four-part cooperation metrics established. Missing intervention timestamp leaves latencyHours as null.

globalCodeData_B4.headline: Oyo Police Arraign Two Suspects Over Corpse Footage and Defamatory Online Videos
globalCodeData_B4.impactVector: The Oyo State Police Command arraigned Prophet Moses Idowu and Oladapo Joshua Dunminimnun following separate investigations into unauthorized morgue video circulation and false, defamatory social media publications concerning late gospel singer Olayemi Bayonle Bolaji and his family. Idowu was remanded in a correctional facility with proceedings adjourned to December 2, 2026, while Dunminimnun, arrested November 12, 2026, was arraigned and adjourned to December 11, 2026. globalCodeData_B4.headline: Taraba Police Launch Investigation After Armed Attack Kills MACBAN Chairman in Takum
globalCodeData_B4.impactVector: The Taraba State Police Command commenced an investigation following an attack by armed men on a motorcycle at the Takum residence of MACBAN Chairman Alhaji Ibrahim Saidu on Sunday evening, November 8, 2026.
